outcome: Compose original dance works, choosing compositional processes and structures that suit their subject matter.
Use compositional craft to support the intention, form and content of a dance, with contrast between works.
Reflect critically on compositional problems met and possible solutions.
Explore dances from more than one culture or tradition, gaining physical and theoretical understanding.
Compare historical contexts, then and now, of two dance cultures or traditions.
Compare the dance elements of two styles, one familiar and one unfamiliar.
Carry out an individual investigation comparing two dance styles from different cultures.
Develop movement skills suited to the dancer's performance.
Show clarity in space, time, dynamics and movement qualities that suit the work.
Communicate expressively with other performers and the audience, interpreting the dance's intention.
